sloka: हर्म्य प्रासाद संबधम् स्त्री सहस्र निषेवितम् ।नाना पक्षि गणैः जुष्टम् नाना रत्न समन्वितम् ॥३-५५-७॥
transliteration: harmya prāsāda saṁbadham strī sahasra niṣevitam ।nānā pakṣi gaṇaiḥ juṣṭam nānā ratna samanvitam ॥3-55-7॥

translations.english: His home was a complex of palaces and mansions served by thousands of women. It was an abode of different flocks of birds. It had captivating pillars studded with gold, crystals, silver, diamonds and vaiduryas. It resounded with wonderful sounds of drums. Its golden entrances were glittering.
translations.hindi: श्रीराम के धनुष से छूटे हुए सुवर्णभूषित वाण, राक्षसा के शरीर को उसी प्रकार वेध डालेगें, जिस प्रकार गङ्गा की लहरें किनारो को ध्वस्त कर डालती हैं
